'''Ulos Varellie''' was a henchman for [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Every possible depictions of Ulos Varellie]]
Ulos Varellie was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
